Can the Metuselah who put put Powerbase Mexico City self take a D-action
to steal the counters from it.

Tomten.

Messages.Author: Lupus Australis
Messages.Body:
On Sat, 31 Jan 1998, Per Stening wrote:

> Can the Metuselah who put put Powerbase Mexico City self take a D-action
> to steal the counters from it.

No. One cannot take directed actions against oneself, unless it is
specifically allowed by card text.

The only card that specifically allows this is Rampage. In such cases,
nobody can block the action (not, at least, without benefit of Eagle's
Sight or some such).
